# Common Agent Rules

- Read `AGENTS.md`, `.ai/architecture.yaml`, `.ai/rules/common.md`, `.ai/service.yaml`, `.ai/commands.yaml`, the relevant `.ai/workflows/*` file, and affected contracts before edits.
- Capture `git status --short` and `git diff`, then run `./scripts/check-agent-policy.sh`. Stop fail-closed on any baseline failure.
- Preserve service ownership and public compatibility. Never copy another service's canonical data into Planner.
- Use one issue, repository, worktree, branch, and agent thread per independently deliverable cross-repository change.
- Keep secrets, raw evidence, prompts, and provider responses out of source and operational planning records.
- Domain and use cases depend only on ports. Concrete PostgreSQL and HTTP clients belong to infrastructure.
- Update tests and owned documentation with every contract, schema, fingerprint, or planning-policy change.
- Run only commands declared in `.ai/commands.yaml`; commands marked `requires_approval: true` need explicit owner approval.
- Rerun `./scripts/check-agent-policy.sh` and all scope-relevant commands after edits. Failed, skipped, or missing evidence forbids completion.
